messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "losing weight during pregnancy could harm the unborn baby even if overweight"
set: ["losing weight during pregnancy could harm the unborn baby even if overweight", "could harm the baby", "seizure during pregnancy could harm mother and baby", "may harm unborn baby", "not expected to harm unborn baby", "may harm unborn baby if taken at 20 weeks of pregnancy or later", "not known if it could harm a nursing baby", "not known whether will harm an unborn baby", "can harm an unborn baby or cause birth defects", "during pregnancy", "unknown if harmful to unborn baby", "risk to unborn baby", "may harm your baby", "may harm breastfeeding baby", "may harm nursing baby", "higher during pregnancy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
